spans.s:
गृ {c1c} P. (गरति)
1 To sprinkle,
moisten, wet.
--2 To grant.

गॄ {vI.v} {c9c} P. (गृणाति, गूर्ण)
1 To
utter a sound, call out, invoke, नामापि
नाम गृणताममृतत्वाय कल्पतां

.
--3 To relate,
promulgate.
--4 To praise, extol;
केचिद्धीताः प्रांजलयो गृणंति

. {vII.v} {c6c} P. (गिरति or
गिलति)
1 To swallow, devour, eat
up.
--2 To send forth, pour out, spit
out, or eject, from the mouth.
--WITH अव (Atm.) to eat, devour;
तथावगिरमाणैश्च पिशाचैर्मांसशोणितं

. {vIII.v} {c10c} A. (गारयते)
1 To
make known, relate.
--2 To teach.
